methods.description: Trusted baseline code verifies the entire scripts namespace, bounded live input inventory, immutable candidate Git data and versioned shared differential geometry. Synthetic valid/malicious/partial-fetch/combined-neighbor controls use retained helper/library bytes at baseline and candidate wrapper/test bytes listed as outputs. Positive controls are permitted paths; negative controls must reject unsafe proposals; mixed combined fixtures verify both. No automatic water exception, geographic repair or ownership inference. Same-input smoke pins a candidate implementation checkpoint and is archived compatibility evidence only. No main footprint blobs were decoded for that smoke; their Git object inventories are preserved rather than represented as full-byte geometry validation.
methods.software: Node24; Python3.12; Shapely2.1.2/GEOS3.13.1; pyproj3.7.2; Git shallow partial file-protocol fixture
methods.units: control counts; diagnostic geometry uses source-coordinate square degrees, not ellipsoidal area measurements

metrics.scope: Synthetic candidate implementation controls against unchanged immutable helper/library source at baseline; not a measurement of baseline map gaps.

conclusions.text: Implementation and controlled trust-boundary evidence only. Source-backed exception adjudication, real hosted Git authentication/mandatory-gate readback, border repairs and publication remain outstanding. No territorial, hydrological or historical approval.

commands: Current controls retain candidate code file hashes; synthetic commits/timing logs are not used as deterministic receipts. Earlier de8f22d smoke is explicitly frozen premerge implementation evidence, not current main execution.
